Organic Ashwagandha
Ashwagandha is an Ayurvedic herb commonly used in traditional Indian medicines. Through 14 years of careful research and development with our partners we have perfected the way to extract the full spectrum of nutrients from the Ashwagandha root to give you the most potent and effective version of Ashwagandha on the market today.
Does not contain any fillers, binders, rice flour, alcohol, synthetic solvents, silica, magnesium stearate or any other artificial ingredients or preservatives

What is Ayurveda?
Ayurveda, meaning 'Knowledge of Life' is a 5000 year old holistic healing system from India that promotes longevity, balance and happiness. Ayurveda helps sustain wellbeing by applying the inherent ethics of nature to bring the person back into equilibrium with their pure self. Ayurveda places great emphasis on prevention of illness and by rebalancing through appropriate nutrition, exercise, relaxation and lifestyle choices, we can help you live a much fuller life.
